description: Sidecar contract hardening (ADR-159). POST /api/v1/fatwa/ask with a 2 MB body -> 413 request_too_large (forwarder cap 1 MB, before any upstream call). POST /api/v1/quran/hifz/attempts/{id}/grade with a 33 MB audio body -> 413 hifz_audio_too_large. A sidecar that sleeps past the route timeout -> 503 with the route's code (fatwa_ask_unavailable / hifz_asr_unavailable). SIDECAR_URL unset -> 503 before any auth check.
